actions_or_findings.title: Staggered concurrent 401s still rotate twice and clear the successful session
actions_or_findings.trigger: Concurrent requests use the old access token, but one 401 arrives after the first refreshInFlight promise has settled
actions_or_findings.rationale: A state-free Node harness reproduced two refresh rotations. The second rotation revoked the first replacement session; the first request's retry then received 401 and cleared the newer successful session. refreshInFlight only coalesces overlapping 401 handlers, not staggered responses from the same concurrent batch.

actions_or_findings.title: WeChat-bind credential failure clears an otherwise valid session
actions_or_findings.trigger: /auth/wechat/bind returns 401 for an invalid or expired WeChat code
actions_or_findings.rationale: wechatBind is used by the profile page but is absent from CREDENTIAL_AUTH_PATHS. Its credential-level 401 therefore triggers refresh/retry and ultimately sendUnauthorizedToLogin, clearing the valid SMS/password session. The round-1 credential-auth 401 remediation does not fully hold.

actions_or_findings.title: issue_invite does not lock EmployeeInvite and has inverted lock ordering
actions_or_findings.trigger: An invite claim races with an administrator reissuing that invite
actions_or_findings.rationale: claim locks EmployeeInvite then Employee; issue_invite locks Employee but reads the active EmployeeInvite without SELECT FOR UPDATE and later updates it. The remediation requiring both rows to be locked is incomplete, and the opposite acquisition order creates a deadlock path.
